R2A-deer-atv-0003.name: 140 m SW of Tearse Creek
R2A-deer-atv-0003.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R2A-deer-atv-0003.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Sumallo River FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Deer here are black tailed deer, the coast form of mule deer: the synopsis calls them "mule (black-tailed) deer" (99%, Rule Book: Region 2 Lower Mainland).
Mule deer winter range u-2-006 unit MA 18-46 (official), 230 m N. Counts from October.
Cutblock harvested 2012 (14 years old), right here.
Habitat zone Coastal Western Hemlock (CWHms4): coast forest, where black tailed deer are among the most common large mammals (95%) and use logged ground often (80%) (lesson: Wet forests).
Private fields 1.2 km SE: deer feed on field edges (fields are private).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 2 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from City of Delta, about 168 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.23385, -121.23378, where the truck road ends (Sumallo River FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 2.0 km on Sumallo-Ski Hill FSR by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 240 m SE, climb about 29 m.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2012 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 2-2, Region 2. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
